title: Modern Standard Library Utilities knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarizes the core idea of “Modern Standard Library Utilities” in standard C++?
options: One successful run proves that every input and platform is handled correctly.
Type rules and object lifetime do not matter once a program compiles.
A string_view does not own its characters, so the referenced storage must outlive the view.
A compiler extension is guaranteed by every C++ implementation.
questions.answer_key: A string_view does not own its characters, so the referenced storage must outlive the view.
questions.explanation: The syllabus topic is “Modern Standard Library Utilities”. A string_view does not own its characters, so the referenced storage must outlive the view.

questions.prompt: When practicing “Modern Standard Library Utilities”, which approach gives the strongest initial evidence?
options: Copy a longer program without identifying its inputs or outputs.
State the preconditions, trace a minimal example and test a boundary or failure case.
Remove warnings and only test the ordinary happy path.
Assume the compiler default and language version are the same everywhere.
questions.answer_key: State the preconditions, trace a minimal example and test a boundary or failure case.
questions.explanation: Focused experiments with stated assumptions provide more useful evidence than an unexplained successful run.

questions.prompt: What should you do if an example related to “Modern Standard Library Utilities” depends on standard-version or toolchain support?
options: Check the language/tool reference and record the selected standard and implementation assumptions.
Treat all draft features as universally implemented.
Replace the standard-library requirement with a compiler-specific function without a note.
Assume that syntax accepted by one compiler is portable ISO C++.
questions.answer_key: Check the language/tool reference and record the selected standard and implementation assumptions.
questions.explanation: Standard mode and feature support must be checked explicitly; the course marks newer and implementation-dependent facilities accordingly.
